name: PSC_ROM_EC_I2C_EXT_MSG_FAIL
description: Fail to enable I2C0 for Ext Messaging interface
resolution: PSC ROM failed to initialize the I2C0 external messaging interface. Reboot the system. If the same error code persists, this indicates a hardware problem. Contact NVIDIA for further assistance.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_BOOT_MODE_SEL_FAIL
description: Fail to Detect Boot Mode and Boot Device
resolution: PSC ROM failed to detect the boot mode and boot device. This is typically caused by an incorrect strap configuration. Check the strap values in the BMC/HMC and compare them to the documented values for the platform. Contact NVIDIA if the strap values appear correct.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_USB_EXT_MSG_FAIL
description: Fail to Enable USB composite device
resolution: PSC ROM failed to enable the USB composite device. Reboot the system. If the same error code persists, this indicates a hardware problem. Contact NVIDIA for further assistance.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_EROT_GRANT_FAIL
description: Timeout to get FW QSPI access from eROT
resolution: PSC ROM timed out waiting for the eROT to grant access to the firmware QSPI flash. Check the eROT BOOT_COMPLETE status and Redfish messages for eROT failures. Reboot the system. If the issue persists, contact NVIDIA.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_QSPI0_DEV_FAIL
description: Fail to Initialize QSPI as Boot Device
resolution: PSC ROM failed to initialize the QSPI0 flash device. If eROT is present, verify that QSPI read operations are functioning. Reboot the system. If the issue persists with eROT present, contact the eROT firmware vendor. If no eROT is present, contact NVIDIA.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_USB2_DEV_FAIL
description: Fail to Initialize USB2 RCM as Boot Device
resolution: PSC ROM failed to initialize the USB2 device for recovery. Try the following steps: 1) Reboot the system. 2) Verify the USB cable is connected to the host. 3) Reconnect the USB cable. 4) Try connecting to a different port on the host. If all of the above fail, contact NVIDIA.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_OCPRC_DEV_FAIL
description: Fail to Initialize OCP Recovery as Boot Device
resolution: PSC ROM failed to initialize OCP Recovery as a boot device. Power off and power on the system. If the same error persists, contact NVIDIA.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_BOOT_CHAIN_EXHAUST
description: All boot chains exhausted
resolution: The device failed to boot after attempting both boot chains. Power off and power on the system. If the same issue persists, reflash the firmware images.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_S2A_HEADER_CHECK_FAIL
description: Invalid S2A blob header
resolution: The S2A DOT blob header is corrupted. The S2A DOT blob is provided by the OEM. The device will automatically reboot to read from the next slot. If both slots are corrupted, the device will enter recovery mode. Contact the OEM for a valid S2A DOT blob.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_S2A_SANITY_FAIL
description: Sanity checks failed for S2A blob
resolution: The S2A DOT blob failed sanity checks and appears corrupted. The S2A DOT blob is provided by the OEM. The device will automatically reboot to read from the next slot. If both slots are corrupted, the device will enter recovery mode. Contact the OEM for a valid S2A DOT blob.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_S2A_INTEGRITY_FAIL
description: Fail to authenticate S2A blob
resolution: The S2A DOT blob failed authentication and appears corrupted. The S2A DOT blob is provided by the OEM. The device will automatically reboot to read from the next slot. If both slots are corrupted, the device will enter recovery mode. Contact the OEM for a valid S2A DOT blob.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_S2A_KEY_REVOKED
description: Keys from S2A blob are revoked
resolution: The signing keys in the S2A DOT blob have been revoked. The device will automatically reboot to read from the next slot. If the next slot also has the same error, the device will enter recovery mode. Contact the OEM to obtain a new S2A DOT blob with a valid key index.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_DOT_SLOT_EXHAUST
description: Fail to find valid S2A/DOT blob
resolution: No valid DOT slot is available. The device will not boot and will enter recovery mode. Repair the DOT to resume booting. Check the DOT error codes from previous boots to understand the issue with the DOT blob.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_MUTABLE_DOT_HEADER_CHECK_FAIL
description: Invalid Mutable DOT blob header
resolution: The Mutable DOT blob header is corrupted. The device will automatically reboot to read from the next slot. If the next slot also has the same error, the device will enter recovery mode. Reflash the firmware with valid images.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_MUTABLE_DOT_INTEGRITY_FAIL
description: Fail to authenticate Mutable DOT blob
resolution: The Mutable DOT blob failed authentication and appears corrupted. The device will automatically reboot to read from the next slot. If the next slot also has the same error, the device will enter recovery mode. Reflash the firmware with valid images.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_MUTABLE_DOT_SANITY_FAIL
description: Sanity checks failed for Mutable DOT blob
resolution: The Mutable DOT blob failed sanity checks and appears corrupted. The device will automatically reboot to read from the next slot. If the next slot also has the same error, the device will enter recovery mode. Reflash the firmware with valid images.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_VOLATILE_DOT_PARITY_FAIL
description: Ownership ram parity check failed for Volatile DOT blob
resolution: The Volatile DOT blob in ownership RAM has a parity error. The Volatile DOT blob contains the CAK. The device will reboot. To recover, send a correct Volatile DOT blob.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_VOLATILE_DOT_HEADER_CHECK_FAIL
description: Invalid Volatile DOT blob header
resolution: The Volatile DOT blob header in ownership RAM is corrupted. The Volatile DOT blob contains the CAK. The device will reboot. To recover, send a correct Volatile DOT blob.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_VOLATILE_DOT_SANITY_FAIL
description: Sanity checks failed for volatile DOT blob
resolution: The Volatile DOT blob in ownership RAM failed sanity checks. The Volatile DOT blob contains the CAK. The device will reboot. To recover, send a correct Volatile DOT blob.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_FMC_CSH_SANITY_FAIL
description: Sanity checks failed for PSC-FMC CSH
resolution: The PSC-FMC image is corrupted. The device will reboot and attempt to boot from the alternate chain. If the alternate chain also fails, the device will enter recovery mode. Reflash the firmware with valid images to recover.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_FMC_CSH_AUTHZ1_FAIL
description: Failed to validate stage 1 authenticity of PSC-FMC
resolution: The PSC-FMC image failed stage 1 authentication. The device will reboot and attempt to boot from the alternate chain. If the alternate chain also fails, the device will enter recovery mode. Reflash the firmware with valid images to recover.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_FMC_CSH_AUTHZ2_FAIL
description: Failed to validate stage 2 authenticity of PSC-FMC
resolution: The PSC-FMC image failed stage 2 authentication. The device will reboot and attempt to boot from the alternate chain. If the alternate chain also fails, the device will enter recovery mode. Reflash the firmware with valid images to recover.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_FMC_CSH_BIN_LIST_INTEGRITY_FAIL
description: CSH binary metadata list is corrupted
resolution: The PSC-FMC image binary metadata list is corrupted. The device will reboot and attempt to boot from the alternate chain. If the alternate chain also fails, the device will enter recovery mode. Reflash the firmware with valid images to recover.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_FMC_IMAGE_SANITY_FAIL
description: Sanity checks for PSC-FMC are failed
resolution: The PSC-FMC image failed sanity checks and is corrupted. The device will reboot and attempt to boot from the alternate chain. If the alternate chain also fails, the device will enter recovery mode. Reflash the firmware with valid images to recover.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_FMC_IMAGE_INTEGRITY_FAIL
description: PSC-FMC binary is corrupted
resolution: The PSC-FMC binary image is corrupted. The device will reboot and attempt to boot from the alternate chain. If the alternate chain also fails, the device will enter recovery mode. Reflash the firmware with valid images to recover.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_FMC_IMAGE_DECRYPTION_FAIL
description: Failed to decrypt PSC-FMC
resolution: PSC ROM failed to decrypt the PSC-FMC image. This may indicate an issue with the security engine. Power off and power on the system. If the issue persists, contact NVIDIA.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_FMC_IMAGE_OEM_RATCHET_FAIL
description: Fuse rollback check failed for PSC-FMC
resolution: PSC-FMC image rollback protection was triggered when using S2A DOT. The image version is older than the minimum allowed by the fuse settings. Contact the OEM for an updated firmware image.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_FMC_IMAGE_MUT_DOT_SVN_FUSE_RATCHET_FAIL
description: Fuse rollback check failed for Mutable DOT
resolution: The Mutable DOT blob SVN is lower than the value burned into fuses. This is a rollback protection mechanism. Update the DOT blob with the correct SVN.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_FMC_IMAGE_MUT_DOT_SVN_CSH_RATCHET_FAIL
description: Mutable DOT rollback check failed for PSC-FMC
resolution: PSC-FMC image rollback protection was triggered when using Mutable DOT. The image version is older than the minimum allowed by the DOT. Flash an updated DOT or PSC-FMC image.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_FMC_IMAGE_VOL_DOT_SVN_FUSE_RATCHET_FAIL
description: Fuse rollback check failed for Volatile DOT
resolution: The Volatile DOT blob SVN is lower than the value burned into fuses. This is a rollback protection mechanism. Update the DOT blob with the correct SVN.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_FMC_IMAGE_VOL_DOT_SVN_CSH_RATCHET_FAIL
description: Volatile DOT rollback check failed for PSC-FMC
resolution: PSC-FMC image rollback protection was triggered when using Volatile DOT. The image version is older than the minimum allowed by the DOT. Flash an updated DOT or PSC-FMC image.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_FMC_IMAGE_VOL_DOT_CSH_RATCHET_FAIL
description: Volatile DOT rollback check failed for PSC-FMC When CAK is zero
resolution: PSC-FMC image rollback protection was triggered when using Volatile DOT. The image version is older than the minimum allowed by the DOT. Flash an updated DOT or PSC-FMC image.

name: PSC_FMC_EC_FUSE_CRC_FAILED
description: Fail to validate system dielete fuse CRC
resolution: PSC-FMC failed to validate the system dielet fuse CRC. Power off and power on the device. If the issue persists, contact NVIDIA.

name: PSC_FMC_EC_NVDLINK_LS_LINK_FAILED
description: NVDLink low speed link up failed
resolution: The NVDLink low-speed link failed to come up. Power off and power on the device. If the issue persists, contact NVIDIA.

name: PSC_FMC_EC_BOOT_CHAIN_LEDGER_INVALID
description: Sanity checks failed for Boot Chain Ledger copy
resolution: A Boot Chain Ledger copy is corrupted or invalid. If this code is received for both copies, the device will report both chains as not bootable. Otherwise, boot will continue with the valid copy. If both copies fail, reflash the firmware with valid images.

name: PSC_FMC_EC_BOOT_CHAIN_LEDGER_NOT_BOOTABLE
description: Both chains are not bootable
resolution: Both Boot Chain Ledger copies are corrupted or invalid, or both boot chains are not bootable. The device will enter recovery mode. Reflash the firmware with valid images to recover the system.

name: PSC_FMC_EC_BOOT_CHAIN_LEDGER_MISMATCH
description: Boot chain selection mismatch between PSC-ROM and PSC-FMC
resolution: PSC-FMC and PSC-ROM are not in agreement on the boot chain selection. The device will reset with appropriate values so that ROM boots using the correct chain. After reset, the system will either boot successfully or enter recovery. Check for additional error codes from PSC-ROM or PSC-FMC after the reset.

name: PSC_FMC_EC_SANITY_FAILED
description: Sanity checks for L1PT failed
resolution: The L1 Partition Table failed sanity checks. The device will reset and boot into the alternate chain. If the alternate chain also fails, the device will enter recovery mode. Reflash the firmware with valid images.

name: PSC_FMC_EC_DEBUG_TOKEN_SANITY_FAIL
description: Sanity checks for Debug Token failed
resolution: The debug token failed sanity checks. The device will continue to boot, but debug token functionality will not be enabled. Reflash the debug token if debug functionality is required.

name: PSC_FMC_EC_DEBUG_TOKEN_AUTHENTICATION_FAIL
description: Failed to authenticate Debug Token
resolution: The debug token failed authentication. The device will continue to boot, but debug token functionality will not be enabled. Reflash the debug token if debug functionality is required.

name: PSC_FMC_EC_STAGE2_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED
description: Failed to authenticate stage-2 header of PSC-FMC BCT
resolution: Stage 2 authentication failed for the first copy of the L1 partition table. In practice this base/instance-0 variant is not expected to fire because L1PT instance 0 has no stage-2 signature; the stage-2 failure is reported against the specific binary that failed using the per-binary instance variants. For the base case, the device will reset and boot into the alternate chain. If the alternate chain also fails, the device will enter recovery mode. Reflash the firmware with valid images.

name: PSC_FMC_EC_HALT_DISABLED_SOCKET
description: Aborting boot on package 1 as it is disabled
resolution: This error occurs only on socket 1 when it is disabled. The device will not boot further on this socket. To enable socket 1, set PSC-BCT max_socket_count to 2 and flash the updated PLDM package.

name: MB1_EC_NVDLINK_HS_TRAIN_FAILED
description: NVDLink high speed training failed
resolution: NVDLink high-speed link training failed. This could be caused by a firmware issue or a hardware problem. Try falling back to a previously known-working firmware image. If the old image also fails, this indicates a hardware issue. Power off and power on the system. Contact NVIDIA if the issue persists.

name: C2C_LPI_S0_EC_TRAINING_FAILED
description: C2C LPI High speed training failed
resolution: A hardware error was detected. Reboot the system. If the error persists, contact NVIDIA support.

name: C2C_LPI_S1_EC_TRAINING_FAILED
description: C2C LPI High speed training failed
resolution: A hardware error was detected. Reboot the system. If the error persists, contact NVIDIA support.

name: C2C_LPI_C0_EC_TRAINING_FAILED
description: C2C LPI High speed training failed
resolution: A hardware error was detected. Reboot the system. If the error persists, contact NVIDIA support.

name: C2C_LPI_C1_EC_TRAINING_FAILED
description: C2C LPI High speed training failed
resolution: A hardware error was detected. Reboot the system. If the error persists, contact NVIDIA support.

name: MB1_EC_NVDLINK_LLI_INIT_FAILED
description: NVDLink LLI hardware initialization failed
resolution: The NVDLink LLI hardware initialization failed. Power off and power on the device. If the issue persists, contact NVIDIA.

name: PSC_FMC_EC_SVN_CHECK_FAILED
description: Security Version Number check failed for PSC-FMC BCT
resolution: The PSC-FMC BCT image has an SVN lower than the SVN in the DOT. This is a rollback protection mechanism. The device will reset and boot into the alternate chain. If the alternate chain also fails, the device will enter recovery mode. Flash updated images or update the DOT.

name: C2C_GRS0_EC_TRAINING_FAILED
description: Training failed on C2C GRS instance 0
resolution: A hardware error was detected. Reboot the system. If the error persists, contact NVIDIA support.

name: C2C_GRS1_EC_TRAINING_FAILED
description: Training failed on C2C GRS instance 1
resolution: A hardware error was detected. Reboot the system. If the error persists, contact NVIDIA support.

name: C2C_UPHY0_EC_TRAINING_FAILED
description: C2C Training failed on UPHY instance 0
resolution: A hardware error was detected. Reboot the system. If the error persists, contact NVIDIA support.

name: C2C_UPHY1_EC_TRAINING_FAILED
description: C2C Training failed on UPHY instance 1
resolution: A hardware error was detected. Reboot the system. If the error persists, contact NVIDIA support.

name: C2C_UPHY2_EC_TRAINING_FAILED
description: C2C Training failed on UPHY instance 2
resolution: A hardware error was detected. Reboot the system. If the error persists, contact NVIDIA support.

name: C2C_UPHY3_EC_TRAINING_FAILED
description: C2C Training failed on UPHY instance 3
resolution: A hardware error was detected. Reboot the system. If the error persists, contact NVIDIA support.

name: C2C_UPHY4_EC_TRAINING_FAILED
description: C2C Training failed on UPHY instance 4
resolution: A hardware error was detected. Reboot the system. If the error persists, contact NVIDIA support.

name: C2C_UPHY5_EC_TRAINING_FAILED
description: C2C Training failed on UPHY instance 5
resolution: A hardware error was detected. Reboot the system. If the error persists, contact NVIDIA support.

name: MB1_EC_SPD_READ_FAILED
description: Failed to read SPD-hub EEPROM
resolution: MB1 failed to read the memory SPD hub EEPROM. This may indicate a memory module seating issue or a faulty memory module. Verify that all memory modules are properly seated. If the issue persists, try reseating or replacing the affected memory module. Contact NVIDIA for further assistance.

name: MB1_EC_MEMORY_HETEROGENOUS
description: Memories are of different types
resolution: The installed memory modules are not uniform. Ensure all modules are identical in terms of manufacturer, model, capacity, and speed. Refer to the system documentation or existing module labels for confirmation. If mismatched modules are found, replace them with compatible sets. If multiple faults exist, there may be multiple subsequent occurrences even after resolving one instance of the failure.

name: MB1_EC_MEMORY_UNSUPPORTED
description: Memory lookup in MB1-BCT table failed
resolution: This error code indicates missing or corrupt SPD data, which is critical for memory initialization. Due to the lack of essential information, consult the system manufacturer's support resources or contact their technical support team for further troubleshooting guidance and potential firmware updates.

name: MB1_EC_DRAM_POPULATION_UNSUPPORTED
description: Unsupported DRAM population
resolution: An invalid population of memory is attached to the processor. Ensure DIMMs are populated in the correct combination as specified in the system documentation. If the issue persists, contact NVIDIA.

name: MB1_EC_CHANNEL_LOW_COUNT
description: Number of enabled channels are not enough to boot
resolution: The number of available memory channels has fallen below the minimum required to boot. This can occur when too many channels have been retired due to uncorrectable errors or training failures. Verify memory module health and seating. The system may require memory module replacement. Contact NVIDIA for further assistance.

name: MB1_EC_UNCORRECTED_ERROR_OVERFLOW
description: Number of uncorrected error exceeds per GB threshold
resolution: The system has exceeded the threshold for page retirements due to uncorrectable memory errors. The system should be evaluated for RMA. Contact NVIDIA for further assistance.

name: MB1_EC_CHANNEL_RETIRED_TRAINING_BOOT
description: Channel retired due to multiple failures while training at boot frequency
resolution: A memory channel has been retired due to repeated training failures at boot frequency. Verify that memory modules are properly seated. If the issue persists, the affected memory module may need to be replaced. Contact NVIDIA for further assistance.

name: MB1_EC_CHANNEL_RETIRED_UNCORRECTED_ERROR_OVERFLOW
description: Channel retired due to number of uncorrected errors exceeds per GB threshold
resolution: A memory channel has been retired because it exceeded the per-channel bad page threshold for uncorrectable errors. The affected memory module may need to be replaced. Contact NVIDIA for further assistance.

name: MB1_EC_CHANNEL_RETIRED_ALIAS_CHECK
description: Channel retired due to multiple aliasing check failures in previous boots
resolution: A memory channel has been retired due to repeated DRAM size aliasing check failures across previous boots. The firmware identified a mismatch between the expected and actual DRAM size. This may require reflashing the SBIOS firmware. If the issue persists, contact NVIDIA.

name: MB1_EC_CARVEOUT_ALLOC_FAILED
description: Failed to allocate memory training related carveouts
resolution: MB1 was unable to allocate memory for carveout regions. Boot will continue. The instance field (bits [12:6]) identifies the specific carveout that failed to allocate. Refer to the carveout instance list in the platform documentation for the mapping of instance values to carveout types. Contact NVIDIA if the issue persists.

name: MB1_EC_DRAM_INIT_FAILED
description: Failed to initialize memory at boot frequency
resolution: Memory channel initialization failed at boot frequency. Verify that all memory modules are properly seated and are of a supported type. Try reseating the memory modules. If the issue persists, try replacing the affected module(s). Contact NVIDIA for further assistance.

name: MB1_EC_ALIAS_CHECK_FAILED
description: Security check for memory aliasing failed
resolution: The firmware identified a mismatch between the DRAM size reported in SMBIOS and the memory size that was trained. This may require re-flashing the memory BCT (SBIOS reflash). This could also occur if new DRAM was introduced with an older memory BCT. Contact NVIDIA for further assistance.

name: MB1_EC_DRAM_REGISTER_CHECK_FAILED
description: Cross check of memory registers with MEM BCT failed
resolution: A cross-check of memory registers against the Memory BCT failed. This may indicate a memory configuration issue. Verify that the correct firmware is installed for the memory modules in use. Contact NVIDIA for further assistance.

name: MB1_EC_SEGMENT_CTRL_TLV_SANITY_FAILED
description: Sanity check of segment controller TLV failed
resolution: The segment controller TLV data failed a sanity check. Power off and power on the system. If the issue persists, reflash the firmware. Contact NVIDIA for further assistance.

name: PSC_ROM_PC_I2C_EXT_MSG_INIT
description: PSC ROM I2C external messaging initialization - encodes reset reason in instance field

name: PSC_ROM_PC_USB_EXT_MSG_INIT
description: PSC ROM USB external messaging initialization - encodes reset reason in instance field

name: PSC_FMC_PC_NVDLINK_LS_LINK_UP
description: PSC FMC NVLink low-speed link up - encodes reset reason in instance field

name: PSC_ROM_EC_BOOT_IMAGE_LOAD_FAIL
description: Failed to read S2A/DOT image from boot device
resolution: PSC ROM failed to read the boot image from the boot device (QSPI flash or USB). Power off and power on the system and retry. If the same error persists, contact NVIDIA.

name: PSC_ROM_EC_CALIPTRA_ACK_FAIL
description: Failed to commit binary hash measurements to Caliptra
resolution: PSC ROM failed to commit firmware binary hash measurements to the Caliptra security subsystem. Power off and power on the system. If the same error persists, contact NVIDIA.

name: PSC_FMC_EC_STAGE1_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED
description: Failed to authenticate stage-1 header of PSC-FMC BCT
resolution: Stage 1 authentication of the PSC-FMC BCT failed. The device will reset and boot into the alternate chain. If the alternate chain also fails, the device will enter recovery mode. Reflash the firmware with valid images.

name: PSC_FMC_EC_MEM_FUSE_CRC_FAILED
description: Memory-die Fuse CRC check failed
resolution: The memory-die fuses have failed a CRC check, indicating the fuses are damaged. The device will not boot. This is not expected to be seen in production and generally requires module replacement. Contact NVIDIA.

name: PSC_FMC_EC_CALIPTRA_MAILBOX_FAILED
description: Failed to load Caliptra Firmware using mailbox
resolution: PSC-FMC was unable to commit firmware hashes to the Caliptra security subsystem via mailbox. The device will continue to boot, but Caliptra attestation will not be available. Contact NVIDIA if this issue persists.

name: PSC_FMC_EC_CSA_FAILED
description: Cross socket attestation failed (boot chain mismatch)
resolution: Cross-socket attestation failed because the two sockets are running different boot chains. This is only expected on a multi-socket Strata system. Verify that both sockets are running the same boot chain and that flash contents are consistent across sockets. Reflash with matching images on both sockets. If the issue persists, contact NVIDIA.

name: PSC_FMC_EC_DOT_FAILED
description: DOT operation failed
resolution: A DOT operation has failed. The failed operation type is indicated in the instance field. The device will reset. Re-attempt the DOT operation. If the issue persists, contact NVIDIA.

name: PSC_FMC_EC_EARLY_BOOTVARS_LOAD_FAILED
description: Failed to load valid early boot variable
resolution: No valid early boot variable (CMOS) data was found. The system will boot with default settings from BCT records. Any custom settings previously configured through the UEFI menu will need to be reapplied. If this error is seen repeatedly, it may indicate a hardware issue. Contact NVIDIA if the problem persists.

name: PSC_FMC_ED_PRECHANGE_SCB_FAILED
description: Socket ID pre-WAR SCB failed
resolution: The socket ID pre-workaround failed because the SCB bit 14 remained high. Power off and power on the device. If the issue persists, contact NVIDIA.

name: PSC_FMC_ED_PRECHANGE_SDIE_STRAP_FAILED
description: Socket ID pre-WAR S-die strap failed
resolution: The socket ID pre-workaround failed because the S-die strap package ID did not drop to 0 as expected. Power off and power on the device. If the issue persists, contact NVIDIA.

name: PSC_FMC_ED_CHANGE_S_C_FAILED
description: Socket ID WAR S/C state failed
resolution: The socket ID workaround failed because the C-die is not in the expected state. Power off and power on the device. If the issue persists, contact NVIDIA.

name: PSC_FMC_ED_CHANGE_S_C_FAILED_AFTER_APPLY
description: Socket ID WAR S/C state failed after apply
resolution: The socket ID workaround was applied, but the C-die is still not in the expected state. Power off and power on the device. If the issue persists, contact NVIDIA.

name: PSC_FMC_EC_CSA_FAILED_HASH_MISMATCH
description: Cross socket attestation failed (hash mismatch)
resolution: Cross-socket attestation failed a hash comparison between the two sockets. This typically indicates one of: incorrect fusing, mismatched SBIOS firmware between sockets, or different boot chains booting on the two sockets. Verify that both sockets are running the same SBIOS image and boot chain, and capture SOL/UART logs to confirm. If the issue persists after re-flashing matching images, contact NVIDIA.

name: PSC_FMC_EC_STAGE2_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED_CMET_COPY_1
description: Failed to authenticate stage-2 header of CMET (first copy)
resolution: Stage-2 authentication failed for the first copy of CMET (Caliptra Manifest Extension Table) - typically because CMET SHA is invalid or CMET has not yet been written. PSC will continue booting; RAS-FW later detects the same condition and rewrites a new CMET to flash, after which subsequent boots no longer report this code. Repeated occurrences after CMET has been written, or boot failures correlated with this code, should be reported to NVIDIA.

name: PSC_FMC_EC_STAGE2_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED_CMET_COPY_2
description: Failed to authenticate stage-2 header of CMET (second copy)
resolution: Stage-2 authentication failed for the second copy of CMET (Caliptra Manifest Extension Table) - typically because CMET SHA is invalid or CMET has not yet been written. PSC will continue booting; RAS-FW later detects the same condition and rewrites a new CMET to flash, after which subsequent boots no longer report this code. Repeated occurrences after CMET has been written, or boot failures correlated with this code, should be reported to NVIDIA.

name: MB1_EC_FUSE_RECORD_INTEGRITY_FAILED
description: Fuse record integrity check failed
resolution: MB1 detected a fuse record integrity failure. Power off and power on the system. If the issue persists, contact NVIDIA.

name: MB1_EC_RAS_POLL_FAILED
description: RAS poll failed
resolution: MB1 failed to poll the RAS firmware. Power off and power on the device. If the issue persists, contact NVIDIA.

name: MB1_EC_CHANNEL_RETIRED_TRAINING
description: Channel retired due to multiple failures while training at higher frequency
resolution: A memory channel has been retired due to repeated training failures at POR frequency. Verify that memory modules are properly seated. If the issue persists, the affected memory module may need to be replaced. Contact NVIDIA for further assistance.

name: MB1_EC_NVLINK_C2C_TRAIN_FAILED
description: NVLink C2C training failed
resolution: NVLink C2C link training failed. This may indicate a seating issue with the module on the baseboard. Try reseating the module. If the issue persists, try reflashing the firmware to verify training values are not problematic. Reboot and contact NVIDIA if the issue persists.

name: MB1_EC_NVCLINK_TRAIN_FAILED
description: NVCLink UPHY training failed
resolution: NVCLink UPHY link training failed. Power off and power on the system. If the issue persists, contact NVIDIA.

name: MB1_EC_DRAM_ECC_FAILED
description: Failed to initialize ECC memory of DRAM carveouts
resolution: An uncorrectable memory error was seen during ECC initialization at boot. A reset will occur as a result of this error. On the subsequent boot, a CPER message identifying the uncorrectable memory error is expected. The affected memory address will be retired and boot should be able to continue. No troubleshooting is needed for a single occurrence. If this error is seen repeatedly, contact NVIDIA.

name: PSC_FMC_PC_BOOT_MODE_PREBOOT_DIAG
description: PSC-FMC entered PreBoot Diagnostic Boot mode

name: MB2_PC_CCPLEX_PREBOOT_DIAG_ENTRY
description: MB2 entered CCPLEX Preboot Diagnostic mode
